record.field: Shows the "My Approvals" menu for users who primarily review and approve/refuse requests. Not required to act as an approver — that right comes from being assigned on the request, regardless of group membership. No configuration access.
Held by everyone a step names or an approver delegates to, and granted on that. Lets its members read the document of a request they are deciding, while they decide it. Grants nothing else.
A step that walks to the approver whose limit covers the amount reads everyone's limits, the grants they qualify and the managers it climbs, whoever routes the request.
System administrator with full access to approvals configuration and all requests.
